subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork PR path, or replace it with a fresh current-main Debug Snapshots fix in the target repository?
rationale: The bug is still present, but a linked open fork PR already proposes this repair and blocks duplicate automation until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow fix against current main with localization, focused tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt And Rebase The Fork PR
options.body: Keep the fork work as the contributor path, but require rebase, current Debug page updates, localization, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer Behind Broader Diagnostics
options.body: Leave this focused issue open but defer repair until broader Control UI diagnostics work is designed.

recommendation.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow fix against current main with localization, focused tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the current Debug page files that a fresh or adopted fix would need to update.
